subtests.name: The parser's clone of a custom element is upgraded and connected before the next script runs
selectedIndex runs the reactions of the new and the old clone before returning
setAttribute() of selected runs the reactions of the new and the old clone before returning
reset() runs the reactions of the new and the old clone before returning
Removing the selected option updates selectedcontent and runs the clones' reactions after remove() returns
Changing the selection from a clone's connectedCallback runs the nested reactions before the nested call returns
